nodes.name: Adding integers
nodes.description: Same signs: add and keep the sign. Different signs: subtract and keep the sign of the larger.

nodes.description: Subtracting is adding the opposite: a - b = a + (-b).

nodes.description: Same signs give a positive product, different signs a negative one.

nodes.description: Multiply and divide before you add and subtract.

nodes.name: Distributing over brackets
nodes.description: The number outside multiplies every term inside the brackets.

nodes.description: Add or subtract the numbers in front of x; the x stays.

nodes.description: Undo the addition: subtract the same number from both sides.

nodes.name: One-step equations: ax = b
nodes.description: Undo the multiplication: divide both sides by the number in front of x.

nodes.name: Two-step equations
nodes.description: Undo the addition first, then the multiplication.

nodes.name: Variables on both sides

nodes.name: Evaluating expressions
nodes.description: Replace x by its value, multiply first, then add.

nodes.name: Reading coordinates
nodes.description: The first number is across (x), the second is up or down (y).

nodes.name: Slope between two points
nodes.description: Slope is the change in y divided by the change in x.

nodes.description: p% of n is p x n / 100.

nodes.name: Solving proportions
nodes.description: Multiply both sides by the number under x.

body.message: Not yet. Subtracting a negative number is the same as adding its opposite: a - (-b) = a + b. For example: 7 - (-3): moving 3 the other way on the number line gives 7 + 3 = 10, not 4. Try this one again.
